svg.title: Soviet Invasion of Afghanistan and the Carter Doctrine (December 1979 – January 1980)
svg.desc: Conic conformal GIS historical atlas map of South-West and Central Asia showing the December 1979 Soviet 40th Army invasion corridors via Termez–Salang–Kabul and Kushka–Herat–Kandahar, the 1979 Iranian Revolution, Mujahideen sanctuary and CIA supply routes from Pakistan, and the January 1980 Carter Doctrine in the Persian Gulf and Strait of Hormuz.
